verdict.rationale: Three.js runs in-browser via WebGLRenderer today (threejs-gh-1, threejs-gh-4) and ships a WebGPURenderer with TSL shading language that works across both WebGL and WebGPU backends (threejs-docs-3, threejs-docs-19, threejs-probe-1), giving a credible forward path. Community feedback confirms it as a mature, widely-used browser 3D abstraction (threejs-comm-1, threejs-comm-13). Missing for 10: explicit payload/bundle-size benchmarks, independent hands-on confirmation of WebGPU renderer production-readiness/performance parity.
